versions.name: the terminal
versions.tofu: pranshu builds terminals and menu-bar apps, so the front door is a terminal now. type anywhere, it listens. i got promoted to a process. pid 54. i nap in the corner pane.
highlights: the home page is a shell: tabs, prompts, a cursor that means it
type anywhere. 1–7 switch tabs. every old command still works
tofu runs as a process in the side pane, hats and all
a tmux-ish status line: deploy, your clock, the season
three terminal themes, each in light and dark

versions.name: from scratch
versions.tofu: torn down to the studs and rebuilt by hand, with me in it. warm paper, small details, a terminal in the floorboards. i live here now.
highlights: three skins, each in light and dark
tofu, and a worklog in tofu's own words
a terminal in the footer. just start typing
live github, with a snake that eats your commits
agent skills, read straight from github
seasonal costumes that come and go by the calendar

versions.name: the template
versions.tofu: before my time. an off-the-shelf template, worn like a borrowed jacket. it did the job. it's gone now, and honestly, fine.
highlights: blur-fade on everything, a dock to get around
a blog with exactly one post: hello world
